```{r libraries,message=FALSE}
# Clean environment
rm(list = ls())

# Libraries
library(vcfR)
library(tidyverse)
library(adegenet)
library(poppr)
library(ggsci)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(vegan)
```

## Data Import

```{r data-import}
# Repo root (robust to rendering from rScripts/ or project root)
repo <- "/mnt/gs21/scratch/maheymoh/karan_project_jgi/AFTER_GATK/clone_correction"
if (!dir.exists(repo)) {
  repo <- if (basename(getwd()) == "rScripts") dirname(getwd()) else getwd()
}

# Load VCF (oak wilt, 92 US isolates), non LD prunned
bret_vcf <- read.vcfR(file.path(repo, "karan_biallelic_TAGs_snps_miss0.1_MAF.vcf"))

# Load sample metadata; strip BOM + trailing spaces from column names, trim values
pop_data <- read.csv(file.path(repo, "metadata.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
names(pop_data) <- trimws(sub("^﻿", "", names(pop_data)))
pop_data[] <- lapply(pop_data, function(x) if (is.character(x)) trimws(x) else x)
```

## Convert VCF to genlight and genind

```{r vcf-gen}
# Convert VCF to genlight and genind for poppr/adegenet
gl_bret <- vcfR2genlight(bret_vcf)
gi_bret <- vcfR2genind(bret_vcf)

# Set ploidy — Bretziella fagacearum is a HAPLOID fungus (VCF GT are single-allele 0/1)
ploidy(gl_bret) <- 1
ploidy(gi_bret) <- 1

# Quick checks
gl_bret
gi_bret
```

## Attach Metadata (Strata & Populations)

```{r attach-metada}
# Reorder metadata to VCF sample order (adegenet assigns strata positionally)
vcf_ids  <- indNames(gl_bret)                        # = colnames(vcf@gt)[-1]
pop_data <- pop_data[match(vcf_ids, pop_data$Sakalidis_lab_code), ]
stopifnot(identical(pop_data$Sakalidis_lab_code, vcf_ids))

# Grouping: Clusters 
pop_data$Clusters  <- as.factor(pop_data$Clusters)
# --- genind object ---
strata(gi_bret) <- pop_data["Clusters"]
pop(gi_bret)    <- strata(gi_bret)$Clusters

# --- genlight object ---
strata(gl_bret) <- pop_data["Clusters"]
pop(gl_bret)    <- strata(gl_bret)$Clusters

# Check
gl_bret
gi_bret
```

## Multilocus Genotypes (MLG) and SNP Clones

```{r mlg-snpclone}
# genclone object from genind
gc_bret <- as.genclone(gi_bret)
gc_bret@mlg   # MLG IDs

# snpclone object from genlight
sc_bret <- as.snpclone(gl_bret)
sc_bret

# Number of multilocus genotypes lineages (original)
nmll(gc_bret)

# Table of MLGs
mlg.table(gc_bret, plot = FALSE)
```

## Choosing a Threshold for MLL (Clone Grouping)

We follow the poppr vignette to use genetic distance to define a clonal threshold

```{r threshold-estimation}
filtered.thresholds <- filter_stats(sc_bret, distance = bitwise.dist, plot = TRUE)

# Collect threshold statistics using bitwise.dist on snpclone
thresholds <- mlg.filter(
  sc_bret,
  distance  = "bitwise.dist",
  stats     = "THRESHOLDS",
  threshold = 0.5
)

# Use cutoff_predictor() to suggest a threshold
pcut <- cutoff_predictor(thresholds)
pcut
```

```{r apply-threshold}
# 1) Contract MLGs into MLLs at the predicted threshold (in-place; poppr API,
#    not a raw @mlg slot assignment — the mlg slot is an MLG S4 object)
mlg.filter(sc_bret, distance = bitwise.dist) <- pcut

# checking number of linages
nmll(sc_bret)

# 2) Clone-correct (keep 1 per MLL per Clusters)
sc_bret_cc <- clonecorrect(sc_bret, strata = ~Clusters, keep = 1)

# sanity checks
nmll(sc_bret)      # MLL count after contraction
nInd(sc_bret_cc)   # how many kept after clone correction
mlg.table(sc_bret_cc, plot = FALSE)   # plot=FALSE: poppr barplot breaks on ggplot2 >=3.5

mlg.id(sc_bret)
mlg.id(sc_bret_cc)
indNames(sc_bret_cc)

# Match the retained sample IDs back to metadata and add their MLL
cc_metadata <- pop_data[match(indNames(sc_bret_cc), pop_data$Sakalidis_lab_code), ]
    cc_metadata$MLL <- mll(sc_bret_cc)

    # Export complete metadata for clone-corrected isolates
    write.csv(
      cc_metadata,
      file = file.path(repo, "results/clone_corrected_metadata.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
```

## Clonal Diversity: Before vs. After Clone Correction

Here we evaluate genotypic diversity ($H$, $G$, $\lambda$, $E_5$) across populations before ($N = 92$) and after ($N = 64$) clone correction using the contracted Multilocus Lineages (MLLs).

```{r mll-diversity-stats}
# Calculate genotypic diversity directly from the contracted MLL frequency tables
cat("=== Pre-Clone Correction MLL Diversity (N = 92) ===\n")
tab_pre_cc  <- mlg.table(sc_bret, plot = FALSE)
div_pre_df  <- as.data.frame(diversity_stats(tab_pre_cc))
div_pre_df$N   <- rowSums(tab_pre_cc)
div_pre_df$MLG <- rowSums(tab_pre_cc > 0)
div_pre_df <- div_pre_df[, c("N", "MLG", "H", "G", "lambda", "E.5")]
print(div_pre_df)

cat("\n=== Post-Clone Correction MLL Diversity (N = 64) ===\n")
tab_post_cc <- mlg.table(sc_bret_cc, plot = FALSE)
div_post_df <- as.data.frame(diversity_stats(tab_post_cc))
div_post_df$N   <- rowSums(tab_post_cc)
div_post_df$MLG <- rowSums(tab_post_cc > 0)
div_post_df <- div_post_df[, c("N", "MLG", "H", "G", "lambda", "E.5")]
print(div_post_df)

# Export MLL diversity tables
write.csv(div_pre_df,
          file = file.path(repo, "results/mll_diversity_stats_pre_CC.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)

write.csv(div_post_df,
          file = file.path(repo, "results/mll_diversity_stats_post_CC.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

## Standardized Index of Association (rbarD) per Population

```{r rbard-by-pop}
# 1. Pre-Clone Correction rbarD for each population (N = 92)
cat("=== Pre-Clone Correction rbarD by Population (N = 92) ===\n")
rbarD_pre_pop <- sapply(popNames(sc_bret), function(p) {
  sub_sc <- sc_bret[pop(sc_bret) == p, ]
  if (nInd(sub_sc) >= 3) round(bitwise.ia(sub_sc), 4) else NA
})
print(rbarD_pre_pop)

# 2. Post-Clone Correction rbarD for each population (N = 64)
cat("\n=== Post-Clone Correction rbarD by Population (N = 64) ===\n")
rbarD_post_pop <- sapply(popNames(sc_bret_cc), function(p) {
  sub_sc <- sc_bret_cc[pop(sc_bret_cc) == p, ]
  if (nInd(sub_sc) >= 3 && nmll(sub_sc) >= 2) round(bitwise.ia(sub_sc), 4) else NA
})
print(rbarD_post_pop)

# 3. Create clean summary tables with dataset totals
rbarD_pre_df <- data.frame(
  Pop   = c(names(rbarD_pre_pop), "Total"),
  rbarD = c(unname(rbarD_pre_pop), round(bitwise.ia(sc_bret), 4)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rbarD_post_df <- data.frame(
  Pop   = c(names(rbarD_post_pop), "Total"),
  rbarD = c(unname(rbarD_post_pop), round(bitwise.ia(sc_bret_cc), 4)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Export rbarD summaries to results/
write.csv(rbarD_pre_df,
          file = file.path(repo, "results/rbard_summary_pre_CC.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

write.csv(rbarD_post_df,
          file = file.path(repo, "results/rbard_summary_post_CC.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

## Poppr Summary on Full Dataset (True N = 92 with MLL as MLG)

```{r poppr-mll-summary}
# Transfer contracted MLL definitions from snpclone to existing genclone object
mll.custom(gc_bret) <- mll(sc_bret)

# Run poppr summary on the full dataset (true N = 92, MLG = 64)
poppr_summary <- poppr(gc_bret, plot = FALSE)
print(poppr_summary)

# Export poppr summary table
write.csv(
  as.data.frame(poppr_summary),
  file = file.path(repo, "results/poppr_diversity_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)
```
